title: Servers, Archipelia servers: add a remote server and trust its certificate once
covers: Archipelia servers tab: add a remote server, trust on first use, test connection
context: A remote Archipelia server is added with a label, an address and its admin token. The first test shows the certificate fingerprint and asks you to trust it once. Later tests use the pinned certificate. The server here is the headless server running on this computer.
changed: views/ArchipeliaServers: remote server form, trust on first use, token replace

setup.label: server
setup.text: The headless server is running. Start it as the optional test of the headless server says, in another terminal, and keep it running.

setup.label: token
setup.text: The text inside the file admin-token under .user-data\Data\server in the bundle-4 worktree. The server writes it on its first start.

setup.label: launch
setup.text: The bundle-4 launch above. If the welcome tour opens by itself, press Skip.

steps: In the sidebar, under Hosting, open Servers, then the tab Archipelia servers. On the left are three blocks: This computer, Remote servers and Servers on your network. Names show in full.
In Remote servers press Add server. Type the Label Local headless, the Address wss://127.0.0.1:38390 and paste the Admin token. Leave Certificate pin empty. Press Add server.

Archipelia tests the server on its A warning box shows the certificate fingerprint with a copy button and the button Trust this Compare the fingerprint with the SHA-256 line in the terminal of the headless s They must match.
Press Trust this certificate. The row status becomes Connected. In the details check Address, Certificate pin (now filled), Server (name and version), Lobby TLS On and Last test.
Press Test connection. The status stays Connected.
Press Replace token, type a wrong token and press Save token. Test connection now shows Not reachable with a plain sentence. Replace the token with the right one and test again.
Open Sessions, New session, turn on Allow direct connections, and choose Remote in the row Where. A row Server appears and offers Local headless. Choose Local again and press Back without saving.
pass: The fingerprint is shown once, matches the server, and Trust this certificate makes the status Connected.
Address, pin, server version and Lobby TLS show in the details.
A wrong token gives a plain sentence, and the right token connects again.
The saved server can be chosen under Where, Remote.
fail: No fingerprint is shown, or it does not match the server.
The server connects with no trust step, or still asks after it was trusted.
A wrong token connects, or the error is a code or a blank line.
Remote stays greyed out although a server is saved.
notes: The admin token is secret. It is stored in the vault, never in the settings.
Remove the saved server at the end with the trash in its row if you do not want to keep it.
Remote is only available with direct connections on once an Archipelia server is saved. With direct connections off, Remote offers archipelago.gg and SSH machines.
